message: We can't share our limits, but here is what we propose: a per-unit price of $5.80, 30% paid at shipment, a 21-day lead time, a 2-day grace period, and a late-price cut of 1% per day capped at 5%. We can't drop the late penalty to zero. If you want to continue on these terms, send your counter within the supported terms and a person at our company will review and sign the final agreement.
